It reconnected after 2 s, 4 s and 8 s. That is the back-off working as it should, so there is no bug here. The cause was the control plane restart that `launch.sh --host-first` does on purpose.

No, that will not work on the iPhone. iOS stops an app's audio session about 30 s after the screen locks, unless the app plays audio the whole time (the `audio` background mode). If we speak the reply while the phone is locked we must keep the session active from the moment the turn starts, and App Review asks why. A simpler first version: speak only while the app is open, and send a notification when the turn ends with the screen locked.
